evaluation_contract.prediction_units: TRAIN-standardized original-channel units; do not invert standardization for normalized macro MSE/MAE.
evaluation_contract.target: x[o:o+48] with original finite/targetmask, never treat imputed future values as observed targets.
evaluation_contract.aggregation: Per channel sum errors and observed counts over requested origins; macro mean across channels; then mean individual seed losses, not prediction ensemble.
evaluation_contract.combined_periods: Combine per-channel error sums and counts across periods, not an unweighted mean of period MSEs.
evaluation_contract.scope: Hog TEST-A/B, Bull E1/E2 and Electricity DEV are exposed development data for v5.

existing_bull_k8_limit.interpretation: Existing K8 RES versus K8 RAW is initialization-matched. K4 versus K8 does not hold random G.down initialization fixed; do not claim an isolated K-only causal comparison.
existing_bull_k8_limit.past_result_policy: Retain the prior K8 unfavorable selection result; reuse is not a new trial or retroactive approval of v2 attempt overrun.

missing_optional: Bull F0 VAL prediction not established by bounded receipt lookup.
v1 initial.pt absent for Electricity selected RES/RAW/LoRA and Bull v1 CURRENT paths.
All-epoch checkpoints are not assumed available.
